verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs has an HTTP API with documented endpoints and multi-language SDKs, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and markdown API reference pages are adjacent documentation aids, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
